cs.t: Over the years I've become a Topre snob. My two daily drivers are a Leopold FC660 and a RealForce 87U. Advantage: Feel and sound the best out of all of my keyboards (including an M1 and a Unicomp). Disadvantage: No backlighting - bit painful to use at night sometimes.
cs.th: Ask HN: What's your keyboard and what you love and hate about it?
